description: This file implements an asyncio task management system with abstract base classes and a concrete class for creating, monitoring, and cancelling asyncio tasks, including detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: TaskManagerParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for initializing the task manager, primarily holding an asyncio event loop.

classes.name: BaseTaskManager
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for asyncio task management, including setup, task creation, cancellation, and retrieval.

classes.name: TaskData
classes.description: Internal data structure for tracking individual asyncio tasks.

classes.name: TaskManager
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BaseTaskManager, managing asyncio tasks with creation, cancellation, and internal registry management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the task manager with configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_event_loop
methods.description: Returns the asyncio event loop used by the task manager.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates and schedules a new asyncio task with a specified coroutine and name, adding it to the internal registry.

methods.name: cancel_task
methods.description: Cancels a given asyncio task and waits for its completion with an optional timeout, handling exceptions and logging.

methods.name: current_tasks
methods.description: Returns a list of currently managed asyncio tasks.

methods.name: _add_task
methods.description: Adds a task to the internal registry.

methods.name: _task_done_handler
methods.description: Handles task completion by removing the task from the registry.
